chars.LANDLADY: a Moroccan woman in her late 40s with hennaed reddish hair under a loose leopard-print headscarf, heavy kohl eyeliner, wearing a shiny emerald-green satin kaftan and many gold bangles
chars.NARRATOR: a thin Moroccan young man of 19 with short black hair and a light moustache, wearing a faded grey hoodie with a torn left sleeve and black track pants
chars.DRUNK: a chubby Moroccan man in his 40s with a bald head, wearing a loosened white shirt and a crooked red tie, flushed red cheeks
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a Moroccan man in his late 20s with a short beard, wearing a blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt and a black beanie

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, narrow tiled hallway of an old big house in Temara Morocco lit by one dim yellow bulb: LANDLADY leading a laughing, swaying DRUNK by the arm toward a room, her finger on her lips telling him to be quiet, seen through a half-open bedroom door from the dark room, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, slightly comic

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a tiny bare rented room like a box with peeling walls, NARRATOR sitting on a thin mattress on the floor holding his phone, staring nervously at his closed door, wide-eyed, a small plastic bag of bread next to him, dim phone light on his face

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, DRUNK standing in the middle of the tiled courtyard of an old Moroccan house, arms raised, singing and shouting loudly with his mouth wide open, tie on his forehead, potted plants and closed wooden doors around, comic

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Late afternoon, the same tiled courtyard of the old Moroccan house in daylight, tired NARRATOR coming home and stopping to ask NEIGHBOUR who leans on his own room door, NARRATOR pointing upstairs with a puzzled face, NEIGHBOUR shrugging with a knowing smile

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same courtyard, NEIGHBOUR leaning close and whispering into NARRATOR's ear while glancing toward a closed ornate door at the back, NARRATOR's eyes wide with shock, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible
